name: PDFBolt
description: Privacy-first in-browser and cloud PDF toolkit for document conversion, compression, and editing.

entries.name: Merge PDF
entries.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one single document.

entries.name: Compress PDF
entries.description: Reduce PDF file size while retaining visual quality.

entries.name: Split PDF
entries.description: Extract specific pages or page ranges from any PDF.

entries.name: PDF to Word
entries.description: Convert PDF documents to editable Word DOCX files.

entries.name: Word to PDF
entries.description: Convert Word DOCX files to PDF format.

entries.name: Protect PDF
entries.description: Add password encryption to PDF documents.

entries.name: Unlock PDF
entries.description: Remove password protection from PDF documents.
